contentThesis: Real expertise can lose when buyers cannot recognize it; positioning makes genuine competence legible.
viewerPromise: See why skill and perceived skill are different business problems.

visualDirection.coreStoryLogic: real competence is hidden until positioning makes evidence legible
forbiddenDrift: unexplained sample books, material boards, restaurants, boutiques, galleries, prestige offices, or contemplative portraits
professional-looking thoughtful poses that do not explain a business decision

assets.spokenMeaning: A better expert can still lose the client to a clearer competitor.
assets.viewerTakeaway: Better skill does not guarantee the client decision.
assets.instantRead: A client selects the clearer option while better hidden skill loses.
mustShow: client visibly selecting the clearer professional
credible losing expert whose deeper skill remains hidden
assets.environmentIntent: vertical consultation table at the instant of selection
assets.actionIntent: the client commits to the professionally clearer option while the potentially stronger expert loses
objectIntent: chosen portfolio beside sealed work sample
assets.conceptualComposition: portrait point-of-view with losing work sample below the chosen portfolio
relevanceAnchors: client visibly selecting the clearer professional
credible losing expert whose deeper skill remains hidden
assets.generationBasePrompt: A client chooses the professionally clearer competitor while a credible expert with deeper but hidden skill loses the decision.

assets.viewerTakeaway: Skill itself is hidden from the buyer.
assets.instantRead: The buyer can inspect evidence but not competence itself.
mustShow: deep competence present behind the work
assets.environmentIntent: professional consultation and work environment where the expert's real work quality is visible to the viewer but cannot be directly measured by the prospective client
assets.actionIntent: the buyer searches for visible evidence while the expert's real competence remains inaccessible
assets.conceptualComposition: wide environmental tableau with evidence trail; left-to-right reveal path
relevanceAnchors: deep competence present behind the work
assets.generationBasePrompt: Show deep competence existing in the work while a buyer is limited to visible traces and cannot directly inspect the skill.

assets.spokenMeaning: Buyers judge an offer, content, website structure, reputation, and recommendations.
assets.instantRead: A buyer evaluates coordinated evidence around one professional.
mustShow: buyer evaluating several recognizable evidence signals
offer, portfolio, interface structure, and social-proof cues without readable text
assets.environmentIntent: procurement table or consultation waiting area; client point-of-decision zone
assets.actionIntent: the buyer compares coordinated evidence signals around one professional
assets.conceptualComposition: client point-of-view with alternatives receding in depth; central void separating competing signals
relevanceAnchors: buyer evaluating several recognizable evidence signals
offer, portfolio, interface structure, and social-proof cues without readable text
assets.generationBasePrompt: A buyer compares an offer, visual portfolio, structured interface cues, and recommendation evidence around one professional, with no readable UI text.

assets.spokenMeaning: Being an expert and being perceived as an expert are different.
assets.viewerTakeaway: Real competence and recognizable competence are separate states.
assets.instantRead: The market recognizes one expert's evidence and misses another's hidden capability.
mustShow: strong hidden competence on one side
equally credible competence made immediately recognizable on the other
subjectRoles: two equally credible professionals including a nonbinary creative director
assets.environmentIntent: neutral professional consultation setting where a buyer can compare two credible professionals and their real work evidence at the same moment
assets.actionIntent: the buyer immediately understands the coherent proof presented by one professional while struggling to interpret the other professional's equally credible but difficult-to-read evidence
objectIntent: unlabeled real work samples with difficult-to-interpret evidence
coherent proof portfolio without readable text
assets.conceptualComposition: medium-wide three-person comparison with two professionals side by side and the buyer in the foreground; scattered opaque evidence on one side and coherent recognizable proof on the other
relevanceAnchors: strong hidden competence on one side
equally credible competence made immediately recognizable on the other
assets.generationBasePrompt: Two credible professionals are shown in one clear business comparison. One has strong underlying competence and real work quality, but the evidence is difficult for the buyer to interpret. The other has equally credible competence presented through coherent, easy-to-recognize proof, so the buyer immediately understands one option while struggling to read the other.

assets.spokenMeaning: Positioning makes real competence visible and gives a clear reason to choose.
assets.viewerTakeaway: Positioning does not invent expertise; it makes real expertise legible.
assets.instantRead: Coherent specialization and proof make the expert easy to choose.
mustShow: credible expert with coherent specialization and proof
assets.environmentIntent: active service counter or field-work setting; peer-referral setting
assets.actionIntent: the client confidently selects the expert after specialization and evidence become coherent
assets.conceptualComposition: layered observational frame with consequence in foreground; near-far contrast between choice and result
relevanceAnchors: credible expert with coherent specialization and proof
assets.generationBasePrompt: Show a credible expert whose coherent specialization and proof make real competence legible, leading a client to choose them clearly.

antiDriftRules: unexplained sample books, material boards, restaurants, boutiques, galleries, prestige offices, or contemplative portraits
professional-looking thoughtful poses that do not explain a business decision
